text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Air Shakur has become a sensational
success after
winning the autumn Tenno
Sho, Japan Cup, and
Arima Kinen.
However, this also means...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Well, that's it for my Twinkle Series
goals. Time to
recalculate my numbers
to figure out what I
should do now.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
In other words, I'll be disappearin' for a
while.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Parcae could use an update. This project

demands complete focus, and the
academy isn't
the place for that.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I'm not asking you to cover for me while
I'm gone.
It's just... I promised to keep
you in the loop at
the very minimum,
and I don't like breakin' my
word.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Huh? Who's "everyone"?
choice_data_list: Did you tell everyone else, too?
Did you tell everyone else, too?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Anyway, I've said my piece. Later.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
There are things only she can do,

incomprehensible to anyone else. She
goes
completely off the radar after that,
but I trust her
to come back.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A few days later...

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: I demand you take me to Shakur, villain!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I know you've hidden her away
somewhere, but I
need to hear her
manner of speech once more to

complete my newest opera! Now, hurry
me to her
side this instant!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Sniffle... Oh, Shakur! Please come hooome!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: She must've gotten tired of me! I know I have a lot... or rather, I know I'm nothing but flaws, but I promise to fix them all!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I can't seem to organize my thoughts
properly
without Air Shakur. Cafe
refuses to engage with
me earnestly.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...I can't make sense of your high-level
talk.
Besides... it's perfect for splitting
conversation
time with Shakur.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Is Air Shakur all right? I haven't seen her
around
lately, so I've been worried! I do
hope she's
okay...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
UUUWAAAAAASGH!
SHAAAAKUUUUUR!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It seems everyone's first instinct upon
realizing
they can't get in touch with Air
Shakur is to come
running to me.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Oh nooo, what should we do? What if
she never
comes back?
choice_data_list: (I wonder what kind of face Shakur would make if she saw this.)

text_block_list.text: Don't worry. She'll be back soon.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Isn't that right, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Um, what do you mean by soon?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
There's one place I know she can't keep
away
from for long, which means she will
certainly turn
up soon!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
But she certainly is inconsiderate to
make
everyone worry so... She really
doesn't
understand anything, does she?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: I think we ought to teach her a lesson.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Gather round, everyone. I have an idea...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
(I can feel my thinking getting sharper,
clearer.
It's so comforting to submerge
myself in the world
of binary numbers,
where everythin' becomes
instantly clear
and consistent.)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
(But... what is this itching, needling
feeling inside
me? My mind is beyond
sated, but my body is
starved for
somethin'. I wanna keep workin',
but...)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...I wanna run so damn bad.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: We've been waiting for you, Shakur!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
What are you doing here? And why'd
you bring
Fine?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
The hell? Why am I back at the
academy? I don't
remember comin'
back...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
You must have lost yourself entirely in
your
thoughts. I knew you couldn't resist
running for
long.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
After all, the thing that drives you is
your fixation
on winning.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Everyone is ready and waiting to race
you again.
Doto, Opera O, Top Road,
Digital...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
And me, of course! But I'll only run with
you again
on one condition.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: And what's that?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: You must think about what you've done.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...What?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
You made us all terribly worried about
you. You
need to think about that.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
What I choose to do has nothin' to do
with any of
you.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Oh, but it does. And you're responsible for making us feel this way. We're all friends now, after all.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: What? Listen, I never asked you to b—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
It doesn't matter whether you asked for
it or not.
You bear responsibility for your
very existence,
and you must understand
that you live on in the
hearts of others.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Someone who runs as incredibly as you
cannot
simply disappear into the ether.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
You must understand the weight and
importance
of your own being. That is
my condition for you.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Well?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I didn't know you thought so highly of
me.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
You're the one who made me hold you in
such
high regard.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Now, what do you have to say for
yourself?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Sorry for going AWOL.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: That'll do.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to head over to the track first.
Come
join us once you're ready!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Oh! And let's go for some ramen like we

promised, okay? The limited-time flavors
will be
gone soon!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... dammit. There goes my plans...
Guess I'm
doing the rest of my
calculations at the academy.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I still don't get what Fine means by
understandin'
the weight of my own
being, though...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: 'Scuse you. I'm not a pet, you know.
choice_data_list: Looks like you got a collar put on you.
Looks like you got a collar put on you, huh.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Next time, you can tell anyone who
looks like
they wanna give me a
headache that I do
whatever I want.
